Fourth round — lost 5–4 on penalties to Arsenal after a 0–0 draw.
Champions League quarter-final — lost 3–1 on aggregate to Real Madrid.
Community Shield runners-up — lost 5–4 on penalties to Arsenal after a 1–1 draw.

overview: Liverpool finished third with 69 points in a season affected by long-term injuries and played largely without supporters. Six successive home league defeats were followed by an unbeaten final ten matches, yielding 26 points and Champions League qualification. That recovery included Alisson Becker’s added-time winner in a 2–1 victory at West Bromwich Albion.

Thiago Alcântara and Diogo Jota arrived in September, and Mohamed Salah led the scoring with 31 competitive goals. Real Madrid ended the Champions League run in the quarter-finals. Manchester United won the FA Cup fourth-round tie, while Arsenal eliminated Liverpool on penalties in the League Cup and also won the Community Shield shoot-out.
Liverpool withdrew from the proposed Super League in April; owner John W Henry apologised for the club’s involvement.
